title: Preparation Lifecycle Event v1
description: Immutable lifecycle event for a checkpoint preparation receipt. Each event is appended to an append-only JSONL ledger and carries an integrity digest, a predecessor digest binding it to the prior event in the chain, and a seal covering all event data.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier — hex token or derived from content

preparation_receipt_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the immutable preparation receipt this event references

branch.description: Git branch binding from the preparation receipt

producer.description: Identifier of the producing operation (e.g. checkpoint.run, prepare_checkpoint.run)

committed_head_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the terminal checkpoint for consumed events

superseded_by_receipt_sha256.description: Preparation receipt SHA256 that superseded this one

prior_event_digest.description: Integrity digest of the immediately prior lifecycle event for this preparation receipt, forming an append-only chain. Null for the first event.

integrity_digest.description: SHA256 integrity digest covering all event data (excluding this field). The ledger authority binds prior_event_digest during serialized append.
